circumstances: Bodaboda (motorcycle taxi) driver based in Kawe, Dar es Salaam. According to an appeal shared by his pregnant wife and amplified by media pages and activists, on Saturday 1 August 2026 in the evening, about five men arrived at his home in Kawe identifying themselves as law-enforcement officials and took him away. His whereabouts remain unknown; his wife has publicly asked for help locating him. No official confirmation.
